主要内容: This 8-K filing from SanDisk Corporation (SanDisk) reports that the waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act of 1976 (HSR Act) for Western Digital Corporation's pending acquisition of SanDisk expired on January 15, 2016. The HSR Act imposes waiting periods on certain transactions to allow for antitrust review before they can close. The expiration of the waiting period satisfies one of the conditions for the closing of the pending acquisition, which remains subject to other customary closing conditions, including shareholder approvals and regulatory approvals. The filing also includes a disclaimer regarding forward-looking statements, which are subject to change based on future events and assumptions. This 8-K filing from SanDisk Corp dated January 19, 2016, outlines the risks and uncertainties associated with the proposed merger with Western Digital’s wholly-owned subsidiary, Schrader Acquisition Corporation. The document highlights the potential challenges, including the inability to complete the merger due to regulatory or shareholder approval issues, disruptions to current operations, integration challenges, and the impact on key personnel. It also notes the possibility of legal proceedings and the uncertainty surrounding the timing of the merger's completion. The risks are further detailed in the preliminary joint proxy statement/prospectus filed with the SEC on December 11, 2015. The forward-looking statements in the filing are subject to change and are not guarantees of future results.
